latest_release.name: v2.22.7: Translation Module Stable, Cross Module Joins, Promotion Events
latest_release.body:
<!--

![v2.22.7](https://res.cloudinary.com/dza7lstvk/image/upload/v1794572651/Releases/v2-22-7-b6119a.png)

# v2.22.7: Translation Module Stable, Cross Module Joins, Promotion Events

The Translation Module is out of beta and is available in all Medusa installations by default, and cross-module joins replace the Index Module as the default mechanism for filtering across module boundaries.

CMS_BREAK -->

## Highlights

### Translation Module Stable

The Translation Module is out of beta is now installed in all Medusa projects by default. You can use translation features to translate content for products, categories, custom data models, and more.

Learn more in the [Translation Module documentation](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/commerce-modules/translation).

---

### Cross-Module Joins Replace the Index Module

Medusa now resolves cross-module queries using direct database joins rather than the Index Module, including in the `/store/products` API route. The Index Module is deprecated and will be removed in a future release.

If you have explicitly registered the Index Module in your project, you can remove it from your `modules` configuration. Cross-module queries via `query.graph()` and API filters that span module boundaries continue to work without any changes.

```ts
// In medusa-config.ts, remove the Index Module registration if present:
// { resolve: "@medusajs/index" }
```

Learn more about [cross-module joins with Query in the documentation](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/query#filter-by-linked-data-models-property).

---

### Security Fix for Index Module

This release also comes with a security fix for users that have enabled the Index Module feature flag in their store. It ensures proper handling of `?` characters in query parameters passed to the `/store/products` and `/store/product-variants`.

If you can't update to this version, we urge you to download and apply the patch of your Medusa version:

- [2.15.3-2.15.5.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/34798601/2.15.3-2.15.5.zip)
- [2.16.0.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/34798605/2.16.0.zip)
- [2.17.0-2.21.1.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/34798620/2.17.0-2.21.1.zip)
- [2.21.2-2.22.4.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/34798621/2.21.2-2.22.4.zip)
- [2.22.5-2.22.6.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/34798629/2.22.5-2.22.6.zip)

---

### Promotion and Campaign Events

Medusa now emits events when promotions, promotion rules, and campaigns are created, updated, or deleted. Subscribers can react to these events to trigger automation workflows in response to discount and promotion changes.

[#17136](https://github.com/medusajs/medusa/pull/17136)

---

### Medusa Cloud Plugin

A new Medusa Cloud plugin integrates the admin dashboard with Medusa Cloud, surfacing in-app announcements about platform updates and new features directly in the admin UI. The plugin is included automatically for projects deployed on Medusa Cloud.

[#17518](https://github.com/medusajs/medusa/pull/17518)

## Features

*   feat(cloud): add Medusa Cloud plugin with in-app announcements by [@shahednasser](https://github.com/shahednasser) in [#17518](https://github.com/medusajs/medusa/pull/17518)
*   feat: Redesign permissions UI by [@olivermrbl](https://github.com/olivermrbl) in [#17778](https://github.com/medusajs/medusa/pull/17778)
*   feat(audit): add the Audit Module with Postgres and Medusa Cloud providers by [@sradevski](https://github.com/sradevski) in [#17787](https://github.com/medusajs/medusa/pull/17787)
*   feat(framework,medusa,types,js-sdk,audit): record API requests as audit logs by [@sradevski](https://github.com/sradevski) in [#17795](https://github.com/medusajs/medusa/pull/17795)
*   feat: improve handling of missing account holders for medusa payments by [@sradevski](https://github.com/sradevski) in [#17389](https://github.com/medusa

Medusa

Documentation | Website

Building blocks for digital commerce

Medusa is an open-source commerce platform with a built-in framework for customization. Use it to build B2B or DTC stores, marketplaces, distributor platforms, PoS systems, and other applications that need commerce primitives such as products, carts, orders, and payments, without reinventing core commerce logic. ## Getting Started The fastest way to get started is with [Medusa Cloud](https://medusajs.com/cloud/), a managed environment for Medusa applications with automated deployments, scaling, and maintenance. [Get started on Medusa Cloud](https://cloud.medusajs.com). To create a Medusa application locally, you need Node.js v22.22.0 or later and a running PostgreSQL database. Then run: ```bash npx create-medusa-app@latest my-medusa-store ``` This sets up the Medusa server and admin dashboard, and optionally the Next.js Starter Storefront. See the [installation guide](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/installation) for all options, or [install with Docker](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/installation/docker). ## Repository structure This is a Yarn workspaces monorepo. Every Medusa package published to npm lives under [`packages`](./packages). | Path | Contents | | --- | --- | | [`packages/medusa`](./packages/medusa) | `@medusajs/medusa`: the main package installed in Medusa applications. Holds the Store and Admin API routes, CLI commands, subscribers, and jobs, and re-exports the modules and `@medusajs/core-flows`. | | [`packages/core/*`](./packages/core) | Core libraries: the framework runtime (`framework`), types, utils, Workflows SDK, Modules SDK, predefined workflows (`core-flows`), Query, orchestration, and the JS SDK. | | [`packages/modules/*`](./packages/modules) | Commerce Modules (product, cart, order, pricing, payment, and more) and Infrastructure Modules (event bus, caching, file, locking, workflow engine, and more). | | [`packages/modules/providers/*`](./packages/modules/providers) | Module Providers, such as Stripe payments, S3 file storage, SendGrid notifications, Redis locking and caching, and auth providers for email/password, GitHub, Google, and OIDC. | | [`packages/admin/*`](./packages/admin) | The Medusa Admin dashboard and the SDK, Vite plugin, and bundler used to build and extend it. | | [`packages/design-system/*`](./packages/design-system) | Medusa UI: the React component library, icons, Tailwind preset, and a Figma import tool. | | [`packages/cli/*`](./packages/cli) | CLI tools: `create-medusa-app`, the `medusa` CLI, OpenAPI tooling, and the HTTP types generator. | | [`packages/plugins/*`](./packages/plugins) | Official plugins, such as draft orders and loyalty. | | [`integration-tests`](./integration-tests) | HTTP and module integration test suites run against a real PostgreSQL database. | | [`www`](./www) | The source of the [Medusa documentation](https://docs.medusajs.com) website. | ## About Medusa Medusa's commerce modules are open-source and freely available on npm. Enterprise Edition features are identified separately in the repository. Learn more about [Medusa's architecture](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/introduction/architecture) and [Commerce Modules](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/commerce-modules) in the documentation. ## Upgrades & Integrations Follow the [Release Notes](https://github.com/medusajs/medusa/releases) to keep your Medusa project up-to-date. Check out all [available Medusa integrations](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/integrations). ## Community & Contributions The core team is available in [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/medusajs/medusa/discussions), where you can create issues, share ideas, and discuss the roadmap. The [Contribution Guide](./CONTRIBUTING.md) describes how to contribute to the codebase and documentation. Join the [Discord server](https://discord.gg/medusajs) to meet and discuss with other community members. ## Other channels - [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/medusajs/medusa/issues) - [Community Discord](https://discord.gg/medusajs) - [Twitter](https://twitter.com/medusajs) - [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/medusajs) - [Medusa Blog](https://medusajs.com/blog/) ## License Medusa uses an open-core model. The core is licensed under the [MIT License](./LICENSE). The RBAC-based Enterprise Edition materials identified in [ENTERPRISE-LICENSE.md](./ENTERPRISE-LICENSE.md) require a commercial agreement with MedusaJS, Inc.
